paragraphs.source_en: “Anna! How does the question of my love come in?”

paragraphs.source_en: “Oh, if you loved me, as I love, if you were tortured as I am!...” she said, looking at him with an expression of terror.

she said, looking at him with an expression of terror.

paragraphs.source_en: He was sorry for her, and angry notwithstanding. He assured her of his love because he saw that this was the only means of soothing her, and he did not reproach her in words, but in his heart he reproached her.

paragraphs.source_en: And the asseverations of his love, which seemed to him so vulgar that he was ashamed to utter them, she drank in eagerly, and gradually became calmer. The next day, completely reconciled, they left for the country.
